dossier.valuation_method: Warranted P/B = (through-cycle ROE - g)/(CoE - g) on common book, probability-weighted across ROE-durability scenarios (excess-returns / composite), triangulated against coastal-discounted peer P/B-ROE map; CoE 14.5% built up for a single-state coastal micro-cap; cross-checked vs normalized P/E; tail sized against the $440M reinsurance tower and ~$99.2M statutory surplus
dossier.thesis_summary: Kingstone is a NY-concentrated homeowners insurer two years into a real turnaround (FY2025 combined ratio 75%, ROE ~43%, book rebuilt to $122.7M, KICO surplus ~$99.2M, debt-free), but its ~$15.4 price (~1.9x book) capitalizes peak, cyclically-inflated returns as permanent. The structural gains (Select re-underwriting >33% lower frequency, 30% expense ratio, growing investment income) are durable; the peak ROE is not (1.2 cat points vs a 7.1 six-yr avg, hard NY market from competitor exits, one-time quota-share earn-in; management itself guides ROE down to 24-30%). On a sober ~16-17.5% through-cycle ROE vs a 14.5% cost of equity, warranted P/B is ~1.3-1.4x and FMV ~$11.0 - roughly 25-30% below the market price. Overvalued / Sell-trim, not a high-conviction short given the hard market could persist (28%-weighted ~$14.5 branch) and a robust balance sheet limits the capital tail.
key_value_drivers: Durability of through-cycle ROE as the hard NY market normalizes (dominant driver)
Select mix-shift continuing to lower loss frequency (~60% of PIF, ~40% legacy still to run off)
Catastrophe load normalization (FY2025 1.2 pts vs 7.1 six-yr avg; 2026 guide 7-10 pts)
Net retention up as quota-share cut 16%->5% (lifts ROE in good years, raises net premium/surplus leverage to ~2.15x and deepens losses in bad)
Investment leverage ~2.55x equity; NII $9.8M FY2025 (+44%) with multi-year reinvestment tailwind at ~5.2% new-money yields
Cost of equity (~14.5%) driven by single-state coastal-cat concentration and micro-cap size
Statutory dividend capacity (~$9.9M/yr) and RBC ~5.6x ACL governing capital-return sustainability
key_risks: Hard-market persistence (risk to the Sell): low-20s ROE for years implies ~$14.5 fair value
Coastal/aggregate catastrophe: single events absorbable (~5-15% of surplus); only a >1-in-100/250 tower-piercing event (>$440M gross) impairs capital
Hard-market normalization / competitor re-entry compressing rate and ROE (the thesis)
Reinsurance renewal cost increases on higher net retention; net leverage rising toward gross as QS falls to 5%
Adverse reserve development (occurred 2022; young Select book; legacy commercial/livery runoff ~$13.4M / 12.5% of net reserves)
NY regulatory / homeowner-affordability legislation; rate-approval lag
Execution risk in California wildfire E&S and Connecticut expansion
what_would_change_my_mind: Sub-80% combined ratios sustained through a normal-to-heavy cat year (upward)
Continued Select frequency gains and profitable geographic diversification lowering CoE (upward)
A capital-impairing cat year (>$440M gross) or material adverse reserve development (downward)
Evidence the hard market is collapsing faster than rate adequacy (downward)
A value-destructive equity raise below book (downward)
